title: Thinking Machines, OpenAI and the impact gap
description: MANILA-based Thinking Machines Data Science is one of 30 companies worldwide recognized as an OpenAI Advanced Partner. The designation, announced at an Aug. 14 media briefing in Makati City and formalized in a joint statement four days later, expands the firm’s role in reselling ChatGPT Enterprise, ChatGPT Business and ChatGPT Edu to Philippine organizations. Founded in 2015, Thinking Machines says it has served more than 150 clients and trained 12,000 professionals since, with 95 percent of its artificial intelligence (AI) pilots reaching production. Panelists kept coming back to one thing that morning: whether all that activity was paying off for Filipino companies.
